name: Trailing Sl
summary: This EA is a trailing stop loss utility that modifies existing positions' stop losses to follow price movement. It does not open any trades itself; it only manages stop losses and take profits for positions matching its magic number and symbol. The trailing activates after a configurable profit threshold is reached.
summary_zh: 这个EA是一个移动止损工具，用于修改已有持仓的止损以跟随价格移动。它本身不开仓，仅管理匹配其魔幻数和品种的持仓的止损和止盈。移动止损在达到可配置的利润阈值后激活。
strategy_analysis: 这个EA的核心策略概念是移动止损（Trailing Stop），用于锁定已有持仓的浮动利润。入场条件方面，该EA本身不负责开仓，仅对已有持仓进行管理，因此没有入场逻辑。出场条件方面，当买单的利润超过TslTriggerPoints个点时，将止损设在当前Bid价格下方TslPoints个点处；卖单则在Ask价格低于开仓价TslTriggerPoints个点时，将止损设在当前Ask价格上方TslPoints个点处。仓位管理方面，EA通过Lots参数设置手数但未实际使用，仓位大小由外部开仓逻辑决定。资金管理方面，EA使用固定的点数来设置止损距离，没有根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。该EA仅遍历匹配魔幻数和品种的持仓，避免干扰其他EA的仓位。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this EA is a trailing stop loss mechanism designed to lock in floating profits on existing positions. Regarding entry conditions, this EA does not open trades itself; it only manages existing positions, so there is no entry logic. For exit conditions, when a buy position's profit exceeds TslTriggerPoints points, the stop loss is moved to TslPoints points below the current Bid price; for sell positions, when the Ask price falls below the open price by TslTriggerPoints points, the stop loss is set TslPoints points above the current Ask price. Position sizing is handled externally since this EA does not open positions, though it includes an unused Lots parameter. Money management relies on fixed point distances for the trailing stop without any dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. The EA filters positions by magic number and symbol to avoid interfering with positions from other EAs.

parameters.description_en: Lot size (not used by this EA)

parameters.description_en: Profit points to activate trailing stop (10 pts=1 pip)

parameters.description_en: Magic number for identifying EA-managed positions

pros: 逻辑简洁明了，专注于移动止损功能，易于理解和维护
通过魔幻数和品种过滤持仓，避免误操作其他EA的仓位
买单和卖单分别处理，正确使用Bid和Ask价格计算止损
从后向前遍历持仓，避免删除索引偏移问题
pros_en: Clean and straightforward logic focused solely on trailing stop functionality, easy to understand and maintain
Filters positions by magic number and symbol to prevent accidentally modifying other EAs' positions
Correctly uses Bid for buy positions and Ask for sell positions when calculating stop loss levels
Iterates positions from last to first, avoiding index shift issues during modification
cons: Lots、Setloss和TakeProfit参数声明但未使用，造成混淆
没有检查trade.PositionModify的返回值，修改可能静默失败
缺少对止损修改最小距离（StopsLevel）的检查，可能导致修改被拒绝
没有考虑点数大小因品种不同而变化的情况，对非标准品种可能不适用
缺少日志输出，难以调试和监控运行状态
cons_en: Lots, Setloss, and TakeProfit parameters are declared but never used, causing confusion
No check on the return value of trade.PositionModify, modifications may silently fail
No check for minimum stop level (StopsLevel), which could cause modification rejections by the server
Does not account for varying point sizes across different instruments, may be inaccurate for non-standard symbols
No logging output, making debugging and runtime monitoring difficult
improvements: 删除未使用的参数（Lots、Setloss、TakeProfit），或将它们集成到实际逻辑中
添加trade.PositionModify返回值检查和错误日志输出
添加SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL检查，确保止损修改不会被服务器拒绝
improvements_en: Remove unused parameters (Lots, Setloss, TakeProfit) or integrate them into actual logic
Add return value checking for trade.PositionModify and error logging output
Add SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL validation to ensure stop loss modifications won't be rejected by the server

risk_points: 未检查止损修改返回值，可能导致止损未被实际修改而用户不知情
未检查服务器最小止损距离，可能导致频繁修改失败
在快速行情中每个Tick都尝试修改，可能增加服务器负载和被限制
risk_points_en: No return value check on stop modification, users may be unaware if the stop loss was not actually modified
No server minimum stop level check, which may cause frequent modification failures
Attempts modification on every tick during fast markets, potentially increasing server load and triggering rate limits
